summary: Approved localStorage proposal persistence scope is implemented and all declared verification gates have reproducible passing evidence.
findings: JSON catalogs, environment-gated seeding, THB price resolution, strict update-by-id behavior, persistent CRUD flows, and missing-id handling match the approved acceptance contract.
hidden_assumptions: Target browsers provide localStorage and crypto.randomUUID, as supported by the current browser verification environment.
residual_risks: Proposal data remains browser- and origin-local by design and is not synchronized across devices.
